title: Security
subtitle: Manage your password, two-factor authentication and active sessions.

demo.title: Demo security model
demo.description: This is a frontend demo. Tokens live in localStorage and every check runs in your browser. A production app must enforce authentication and authorization on the server and should prefer httpOnly cookies.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a strong password you do not reuse on other sites.
password.success: Password updated. Other sessions were signed out.
password.hint: Changing your password signs out every other session.

errors.unchanged: Choose a password you have not used here.
errors.weak: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Ask for a one-time code after your password.
twoFactor.enabledDescription: Sign-in now requires a six-digit verification code.
twoFactor.disabledDescription: Add a second step to protect your account.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.description: Add the secret to an authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
setup.demoNote: Demo mode uses a fixed secret and the code {{code}}. Never ship a fixed TOTP secret.

disableDialog.title: Disable two-factor authentication?
disableDialog.description: Confirm your password. Other sessions will be signed out.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.
sessions.revokeAllSuccess: All other sessions were signed out.

confirm.title: Sign out other sessions?
confirm.description: Every other device will need to sign in again. This device stays signed in.

confirmRevoke.title: Sign out this session?
confirmRevoke.description: This device will need to sign in again. You can repeat this for every device you no longer use.
